The '''Tion Commerce Tower''' was a commercial building<ref name="GCG" /> located in [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gallada]] moved goods and information through the Tion Commerce Tower.<ref name="TCSWE" />
